protocol.arm_budget_definition: new v3 uncertainty interval; c_max>=epsilon => NUMERICALLY_INDETERMINATE_BUDGET/null; nominal only when c_max<epsilon; no clipping

arms.M00p: new CISD 3-point fit at t0; generates NEW B0_prime
arms.M01p: new CISD local g(t0), no fit
arms.M10p: new Ritz8 same 3 absolute points and fit
arms.M11p: same new Ritz8 local g(t0), no fit; primary

protocol.cold_replay: one complete independent source/basis/state/PF/echo/proxy/fit/budget replay; no scientific intermediates shared
protocol.development_status: known N2/CO development conditions; no independent/prospective/transfer guarantee

execution_wrapper.authorization: separate explicit Phase A authorization with actual v3 protocol and complete execution-code hash
execution_wrapper.execution_code_hash_rule: SHA256 compact sorted canonical JSON plus newline of parsed execution_code_identity.json
execution_wrapper.lease_key: SHA256(authorization_id), independent of run_id; all existing states forbid reuse
execution_wrapper.recovery: per-condition immediate scalar recovery, then all-initial aggregate recovery before cold; final recovery before public validation
execution_wrapper.retry: serialization-only from private snapshot; no production retry from the same authorization

fit.scaling: times/t_ref; values/max(abs(values)); numpy.linalg.lstsq rcond=None; unscale coefficients

outcome_rules.safety_repair: valid unsafe M01p and safe M11p, separate from saving

protocol.phase_A: new sanitized source only; freeze all estimates/budgets/code/protocol/source hashes in committed prediction; truth unopened
protocol.phase_B: after actual Phase A freeze/remote/code/source/recovery proof, two ascending six-coordinate truth-only ladders; score final t0 only; v3 prediction/code/numerical binding requires separately reviewed Phase B barrier extension
protocol.research_question: At identical regenerated H/PF/external coordinates, can state improvement and/or selected-time local evaluation reduce QPE budgets safely?
protocol.revision_reason: close physical-production replay/norm acceptance contract before any Phase A observation

ritz.phase_rule: largest magnitude component positive; first tie index

protocol.safety_definition: epsilon_E-|new direct(t0)|-beta K/(t0 B_j)>=0; keep raw slack, invalid/indeterminate cannot support gain
stop_rules: M11p unsafe either condition: resource extension STOP
both safe but target not met: stop micro-accuracy optimization
M01p sufficient and no state_increment: simpler local intervention preferred
state_increment1/2: keep condition dependence; no molecules until success
R0 stops after handoff regardless GO; separate R1 authorization required

systems.coordinate_provenance: prior development fixed external design; not new-source optimum
prior development fixed external design; not new-source optimum

truth_contract.cluster_ambiguity: reject chained connected cluster whose pairwise circular diameter >= gap
truth_contract.cluster_eigenphase: circular centroid of member eigenphases; projected vector must pass eigenpair residual
truth_contract.cluster_vector: normalized reference projection into selected eigenspace, deterministic largest-component phase
truth_contract.comparator: diagnostic only; never used for continuation, t0 selection or estimator
truth_contract.direct_shift: angle(exp(-i E t) lambda)/t, S0 principal-angle energy-origin convention
truth_contract.failure_policy: abort remaining coordinates; no retry/grid/rule rescue; technical, no resource outcome
truth_contract.first_cluster_rule: seed eigenpair uses max ground overlap; if degenerate use its cluster projector
truth_contract.ground_isolation: truth-only original exact state/energy after verified Phase A barrier; no new ground solve
truth_contract.numerical_backend: CPU complex128 native left-product on identity block; scipy.linalg.schur output complex
truth_contract.phase_cluster_comparison: strict <; exactly threshold is singleton separation
truth_contract.phase_cluster_selector: maximum previous-reference projector overlap; singleton equals maximum vector overlap
truth_contract.primary_scoring: only final t0 signed direct shift after both complete six-point ladders PASS
truth_contract.selected_vector_checkpoint: private npy plus identity/hash metadata, create-only/fsync
truth_contract.tie_rule: first deterministic ascending circular eigenphase/real/imag/original ordinal; exact degenerate basis resolved by projector
